purpose: Say that the same thing happens on every occasion.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
Verb dictionary form + たびに; noun + のたびに
Whenever I hear this song, I remember my hometown.
I keep the tickets every time I travel.
Every time we meet, she tells me a new story.
formation: Verb dictionary form + たびに; noun + のたびに
restrictions: Emphasizes recurring occasions rather than a scheduled interval.
mistake: Use ごとに for fixed intervals such as three hours.
